note: Example only. Demonstrates identity x request-surface policy for a commerce profile.

rules.name: Crawler transactional surface example
rules.expression: ((cf.verified_bot_category eq "Search Engine Crawler" or cf.verified_bot_category eq "AI Search" or cf.verified_bot_category eq "AI Crawler" or cf.verified_bot_category eq "Page Preview" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "meta-webindexer" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "googlebot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "bingbot") and ((http.request.uri.path eq "/cart" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cart/")) or (http.request.uri.path eq "/checkout" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/checkout/")) or (http.request.uri.path eq "/my-account" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/my-account/")) or http.request.uri.query contains "add-to-cart=" or http.request.uri.query contains "remove_item=" or http.request.uri.query contains "wc-ajax="))
